# Citation-shaped spellings that no residue pattern claims, one per line, with
# every number written as N. The spelling is the point: a new one means a shape
# the gates cannot see, and that is what TestNoNewUnclaimedCitationShapes fails
# on. A new story number in a spelling already listed here is not news.
#
# This file is a ceiling, not a baseline. An entry whose sites are all swept, or
# that a widened pattern starts claiming, stops appearing and needs no edit here.
# Adding an entry is the decision that needs a reason, and the only two reasons
# are below.

# A story number written into prose without the word "story" next to it, so the
# story-reference pattern cannot reach it. Claiming this shape would mean matching
# a bare number followed by any capitalised word, which reads dates, versions and
# ordinary sentences as residue. It is cleared by hand, not from here.
N-N JSON

# Text that only resembles a citation: a licence version, a font bit range, a
# tool version, a count in prose, a coordinate, and line:column positions in
# assertions.
N.N LICENSE
N-N MUST
N.N (ESL
N (N GUI
N/N, XMPC
N:N NOT
N:N (NOT
N:N, NOT
